key: All this, whatsoever exists in the universe, should be covered by the Lord. Having renounced (the unreal), enjoy (the Real). Do not covet the wealth of any man.
s: The Isa opens eighteen verses that run from renunciation and work to a closing prayer as the body goes to ashes; Śaṅkara, commentary on verse 1, reads the covering as seeing the universe, moving and unmoving, as the Self, whence renunciation, and ‘enjoy’ as protect.
src: Śaṅkara, Īśa Upaniṣad Bhāṣya, verse 1, trans. S. Sitarama Sastri, The Upanishads and Sri Sankara’s Commentary, vol. 1 (1905 printing)

evidence.words: All this universe, movable and immovable, unreal in absolute truth* should be covered by his self, the Lord, Paramatnum, with the idea, “ I alone am all this as being the inner self of all. ” … One who thus contemplates on the self as the Paramatman is bound to renounce the three-fold desire of son, etc., and not perforin Karma … Bhnnjithah means protect.
evidence.lang: English (Sitarama Sastri’s translation of the Sanskrit, OCR as printed)
evidence.gloss: The whole universe, moving and unmoving, is to be covered by one’s own Self, the Lord, with the thought ‘I alone am all this, as the inner Self of all’; whoever so contemplates the Self must renounce the threefold desire for son and the rest; bhuñjīthāḥ means protect.

reason: Second judgement: the refuter is right. Śaṅkara’s gloss on Isa 1 (packet, Sitarama Sastri) widens the verse’s word to ‘All this universe, movable and immovable’, so the earlier ‘all that moves’ narrowed his reading. Corrected the reading to the whole universe, moving and unmoving, seen as the Self, with renunciation following (‘bound to renounce’) and ‘enjoy’ as protect (‘Bhnnjithah means protect’). Also replaced ‘a prayer at the hour of death’, an inference that echoes Paramananda’s note on verse 17, with the day’s own terms: a closing prayer as the body goes to ashes (17). Key verse verbatim, verse.js ok, ref Isa Upanishad 1, at [0]; plain sense faithful; one commentator, so no school needed; src and evidence unchanged and verbatim from the packet; entry-check ok.
